class.name: Skin
class.brief_description: The set of bones a mesh is skinned to, and the bind pose of each.
class.description: A [Skin] holds an ordered list of [i]binds[/i]. Each bind ties one of a [MeshInstance3D]'s skin weight indices to a bone of the [Skeleton3D] that drives it, and stores that bone's [i]bind pose[/i] - the inverse of the bone's global transform at the moment the mesh was authored. A [MeshInstance3D] applies a bind by multiplying the bound bone's global pose by that bind's pose, so a skeleton posed exactly as it was authored leaves the mesh undeformed. A bind identifies its bone in one of two ways, and they are mutually exclusive: - [b]By name[/b] ([method add_named_bind], [method set_bind_name]). The bone is looked up in the [Skeleton3D] by name every time the skeleton changes, so the skin survives a bone being inserted, removed or reordered. This is what the glTF and Collada importers produce. - [b]By index[/b] ([method add_bind], [method set_bind_bone]). Cheaper, but tied to the exact bone order of one skeleton. A bind with a name keeps whatever [method get_bind_bone] happens to hold - [code]-1[/code] for a bind created by [method add_named_bind] - because the index is never consulted. Use [method get_bind_name] to read a named bind, and [method Skeleton3D.find_bone] on the skeleton driving the mesh if you need the index it currently resolves to. The inspector hides the bone index of a named bind for the same reason. Skins are usually created by the importer, and a [MeshInstance3D] falls back to one generated from its [member MeshInstance3D.skeleton] when [member MeshInstance3D.skin] is not set, so building one by hand is only needed for meshes assembled at runtime.

method.name: add_bind
method.description: Appends a bind that refers to the bone at index [param bone] of the skeleton, with [param pose] as its bind pose. The new bind's name is empty, so it stays index-based; see [method add_named_bind] for the name-based form.

method.name: add_named_bind
method.description: Appends a bind that refers to the bone called [param name], with [param pose] as its bind pose. The bone is resolved by name against the skeleton, so the bind still works if bones are reordered. The new bind's bone index stays [code]-1[/code] and is not used; [method get_bind_bone] will return that.

method.name: clear_binds
method.description: Removes every bind, leaving [method get_bind_count] at [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_bind_bone
method.description: Returns the bone index stored on bind [param bind_index], or [code]-1[/code] if the bind has none. [b]Note:[/b] This is the index as stored, not a lookup. A bind that identifies its bone by name never has one set - [method add_named_bind] leaves it at [code]-1[/code] - and this returns [code]-1[/code] however many bones the skeleton has. Check [method get_bind_name] first, and resolve it with [method Skeleton3D.find_bone] on the skeleton that drives the mesh.

method.name: get_bind_name
method.description: Returns the name of the bone that bind [param bind_index] refers to, or an empty [StringName] if the bind refers to its bone by index instead.

method.name: get_bind_pose
method.description: Returns the bind pose of bind [param bind_index] - the transform the bound bone's global pose is multiplied by when the mesh is skinned.

method.name: set_bind_bone
method.description: Sets the bone index that bind [param bind_index] refers to. Has no effect while the bind also has a name, since the name wins; clear it with [method set_bind_name] and an empty [StringName] first.

method.name: set_bind_count
method.description: Resizes the list of binds. Binds added by growing it have no name, a bone index of [code]-1[/code] and an identity bind pose, so each one has to be filled in with [method set_bind_bone] or [method set_bind_name] and [method set_bind_pose].

method.name: set_bind_name
method.description: Sets the name of the bone that bind [param bind_index] refers to, making the bind name-based. Pass an empty [StringName] to go back to using its bone index.

method.name: set_bind_pose
method.description: Sets the bind pose of bind [param bind_index]. See [method get_bind_pose].
